properties.markdownProperty:
A **Remote figure** shows an image that is **referenced by URL** instead of being copied into the project. It has the same properties as a local figure, but it fills in *URL* and leaves *File* empty. It is useful for images that are kept up to date elsewhere (corporate logos, published diagrams), at the cost of needing network access when the document is displayed.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **Yes**. It has the `traceable-object` class, so the *Dependencies* of other objects can point to it (it can also be the target of a symbolic link). - *Can have traces to other objects:* **Yes**. *Authors* and *Sources* point to stakeholders, and *Dependencies* point to any traceable object.
